deviations.why: The sentence became false with this story, and the documentation a story touches has to be true when it lands.

deviations.what: A remembered finding counts only when it is zero or more and under sixty seconds old, so a value dated in the future is treated as absent, as one that is not a number is. STATIC_URL and MEDIA_URL are compared a path segment at a time, and a scheme-relative value covers nothing.
deviations.why: plan.md leaves both readings open; both are covered by tests added in T007.

concerns: Full verify (forge verify --repo . --base origin/main) ran once at the end on the T010 code commit: exit 0, lint, typecheck, test, build, conformance and docs all passed. makemessages -l en --no-obsolete leaves the catalog unchanged and makemigrations --check reports no changes.

TestAgreementCheckOff passes with and without the middleware module present, by design: it asserts that a stopped user is served when the middleware is not listed. I did not probe it by listing the middleware in tests/settings.py.

Mutation probes run by hand against the finished middleware (removing each of: the resolve and sign-out clause, the page-path equality, the static and media clause, the off-site and site-root guards, the anonymous and missing-user guards, the unmounted guard, remembering, writing, writing for a stopped user, storing a datetime, the number check, the path-segment rule, percent-encoding, and the three HX-Redirect rules). Two survived the first pass and are now killed by tests added in T007. The probe scripts were not committed.

AgreementMiddleware reads request.session directly. An authenticated request on a project with no SessionMiddleware raises AttributeError (decisions.md D14 'Revisit if'). It is not covered by a check or a test.

is_reachable() calls reverse('mvp_compliance:agree') without a guard, because __call__ has already ruled out the unmounted case. A caller that uses it directly on a project that does not mount the package's addresses gets NoReverseMatch.
README's status block still says 'No account-area page exists yet', which was out of date before this story. Left alone as outside T010.

With the middleware on in the demo, a demo user with an enforced document outstanding is sent to the page that asks from the landing page, which is not kept reachable until US-4's exempt-URLs setting and US-3's changes to the demo land.
A project whose sign-out address is registered under none of account_logout, logout and admin:logout has it stopped, and this branch offers no setting to keep it reachable; that is US-4's.

In passing I ran 'git checkout -- .' once to undo a throwaway mutation of the middleware and it also discarded one uncommitted test of my own; I wrote the test again before committing. Nothing outside my own work was affected.
